messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — Synthetic canary 'api-canary-eu' failing in eu-west-1. 90% of checks returned 5xx over the last 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 created and routed to emma (oncall). Escalation policy: canary-failures -> oncall -> sre-triage.
emma (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking now. First glance: most failures are HTTP 503 with `upstream read timeout` in the probe logs.
raj: :eyes: I'm pulling the probe logs from the canary runner. If someone can run a quick manual probe it would help.
nate: running a manual curl from eu-west-1 lambda now:
```
curl -v -H "Accept: application/json" https://canary-api.eu-west-1.redwood-infra/synthetic/check
```
nate: getting HTTP/1.1 503 and body `{"error":"upstream timeout"}`
kira: I just checked deploys — a model push to the inference pool completed ~12m ago (model v2.7-beta). Could be related.
emma (oncall): good catch. I'm pausing the canary rollout in the Console now (Console > Deployments > model-v2.7-beta > Pause). Will keep traffic on stable for now.
sre-triage: copying metrics — backend svc-cache-eu shows a large increase in request latency and `connection_reset` spikes starting ~11m ago. No region-wide cloud provider events reported.
raj: grabbing server-side container logs for the model-serving pods. Found repeated `KVCache::Eviction failed` and then `connection reset by peer` in the same timeframe.
nate: also seeing increased tokenization latency on those hosts. Might be memory pressure during warmup after the model rollout.
emma (oncall): initial impact assessment: synthetic checks failing, but customer-facing API 99th percentile latency bump is +120ms in eu-west-1, error rate at 0.6% (brief spikes). Not platform-wide. No outages in other regions.
kira: I've applied a temporary autoscaler tweak to reduce burst spin-ups for the model pool (minReplicas +=1) — gives headroom while we stabilize.
sre-triage: recommend: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) roll back model v2.7-beta from one of the canary pools, 3) avoid autoscaler churn, 4) drain problematic hosts.
raj: executing rollback on one canary subset now:
```
# rollback command (internal)
rwctl deploy rollback --cluster eu-west-1 --pool canary-a --to model-v2.6
```
raj: rollback started, pods are terminating and new stable pods coming up.
emma (oncall): handing off to raj for active mitigation — I'll stay on until rollback is green. If anything escalates tag `@sre-triage` and `@eng-sre`.
nate: after rollback probes are starting to return 200s from the manual test.
nate: manual curl now returns 200 and response time ~85ms.
kira: monitoring shows synthetic failure rate dropping to ~2% then to 0.2% over 4m. Good.
emma (oncall): ok marking the incident as acknowledged + mitigation in progress. Creating brief incident note and follow-up ticket for deeper postmortem and model warmup tuning.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 acknowledged by emma (oncall).
pagerduty-bot: Escalation cleared, incident updated: status = acknowledged -> mitigation in progress. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
sre-triage: please file follow-up with logs attached: candidate causes: model warmup memory pressure, KV cache eviction logic, autoscaler responsiveness. Tag: postmortem/priority-high.
emma (oncall): creating follow-up issue now and assigning to @raj and @nate. I'll update #postmortems with timeline once we have logs consolidated.
raj: note — took a heap snapshot from one of the failing pods, saved to s3://redwood-dumps/inc12345/heap-2026-03-14-22-31.dump
nate: adding sample probe traces to the ticket. Also recommend adding a synthetic check that mimics steady-state tokenization heavy workload.
kira: rolling back autoscaler tweak to normal after pods stabilized. Keeping monitoring thresholds tighter for next 24h.
emma (oncall): final status: canary rollback successful, synthetic checks are green, customer-facing errors returned to baseline. We'll keep the incident open for postmortem artifacts and SLA notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sre-triage: agreed. moving to post-incident monitoring. Assigning next steps: follow-up investigation + improve canary warmup runbook.
emma (oncall): handing off to asynchronous monitoring window. If anything regresses I'll re-open paging. Logging this as INC12345 in the incident tracker.
